name: BlockRun
description: Pay-per-call gateway that leaves nine open-weight models free and keyless.
overview: BlockRun prices every call in dollars before it runs and settles in USDC on-chain, but nine open-weight models are listed at free in and free out with no payment header at all — no account, no key, no wallet. The free set is NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (1M context), Nemotron 3.5 Super 120B, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Bolt, Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, Cohere North Mini Code, Poolside Laguna XS 2.1, Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B and MiniMax M3.1 Flash. Everything else in the 124-model catalogue is billed per call.

privacy.label: Prompts leave your machine to BlockRun

free_access: Nine free models requiring no key, account or wallet
Includes Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B and MiniMax M3.1 Flash
Paid models settle per call in USDC over x402
notes: The free list rotates and is a loss-leader for the paid catalogue. Rate limits on free models are not published; treat them as best-effort.
